# Town of Weybridge municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Megan Sutton (Chair), Kelly Flynn (Vice Chair), T. Charlie Jordan, William Mayers, and Stacey Rainey
Town of Weybridge, Elections page, 2026 results: Kelly Flynn was re-elected (137 votes, two-year term) and Charlie Jordan was re-elected (175 votes, three-year term)

Town of Weybridge, 2025 Town Report, officers table (pp. 5-8): lists the board with Megan Sutton as Chair; the report prints 'T. Charles Jordan' where the directory prints 'T. Charlie Jordan' -- the report's formal roster form governs the person name
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Weybridge, Elections page, 2026 results: Spencer Putnam was re-elected Moderator (218 votes)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 167 (Town of Weybridge): sec. 103: the Selectboard appoints the Town Clerk
Town of Weybridge, 2025 Town Report, officers table (pp. 5-8): 'Town Clerk/Treasurer -- Appointed -- Brenda Jaring'
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 167 (Town of Weybridge): sec. 103: the Selectboard appoints the Town Treasurer
Town of Weybridge, 2025 Town Report, officers table (pp. 5-8): 'Town Clerk/Treasurer -- Appointed -- Brenda Jaring'
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 167 (Town of Weybridge): sec. 103: the Selectboard appoints other town officers, including the Constable
Town of Weybridge, 2025 Town Report, officers table (pp. 5-8): Constable Kristin Bowdish, shown as an appointed officer

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect trustees of public funds
Town of Weybridge, 2025 Town Report, officers table (pp. 5-8): Trustee of Public Funds Diane DaPolito (term to 2028); the other two seats are printed 'Open Seat' and are vacant
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a town agent); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Weybridge, 2025 Town Report, officers table (pp. 5-8): Town Agent Nancy Foster, 'Elected,' term expiring 2026. The 2026 outcome is unpublished, so no holder is minted; Foster is carried as a straggler on issue #163
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a grand juror); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Weybridge, 2025 Town Report, officers table (pp. 5-8): Grand Juror Maura Huddleston, 'Elected,' term expiring 2026. The 2026 outcome is unpublished, so no holder is minted; Huddleston is carried as a straggler on issue #163
